name: B10-0083/2025 (ECR) – Situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on 10 January 2025
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Nicolás Maduro for taking a third term as Venezuela's president without evidence he won the July 2024 election. It calls for a peaceful democratic transition, backs Edmundo González Urrutia as the legitimate elected president, and demands the release of all political prisoners. It also condemns arrests, violence and pressure on diplomats, welcomes new sanctions on Maduro's officials, and supports international court investigations. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament states its position and makes requests to the European Union and other countries.
- **Who it affects:** Maduro's government, Venezuelan opposition figures and prisoners, and European Union diplomats and citizens held there.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, the Organization of American States, the United Nations and Venezuelan authorities.
